name: Sato-Tate conjecture
summary: Potential automorphy of symmetric powers gave equidistribution of Frobenius angles of elliptic curves.

name: Several complex variables via PDE
summary: L2 estimates for the d-bar equation solved problems about pseudoconvex domains.

name: Euclid Books VII-IX: arithmetic as a deductive theory
summary: Divisibility, the Euclidean algorithm and geometric progressions of integers were developed as a self-contained deductive body.

name: Knot problems become group-theoretic: knot groups (Dehn)
summary: Dehn took the fundamental group of a knot complement as the key invariant, treated knot questions as word problems, and used this to separate the two trefoils.

name: Bott periodicity: Morse theory on loop spaces computes homotopy of Lie groups
summary: Morse theory applied to spaces of geodesics on loop spaces gives the periodicity of the stable homotopy groups of classical groups.

name: D-modules and the Riemann-Hilbert correspondence
summary: Systems of linear PDE (D-modules) are matched with constructible sheaves, and localisation matches D-modules with representations of Lie algebras.

name: Hodge theory of harmonic integrals
summary: Harmonic forms represent cohomology on Kaehler manifolds.

name: Hilbert space and integral equations
from: quadratic forms in infinitely many variables
summary: Hilbert and Riesz made sequence and function spaces into an infinite-dimensional geometry with spectral theory.

name: Tensor calculus (Ricci)
summary: Christoffel and Ricci developed coordinate-independent calculus of tensors, systematised by Ricci and Levi-Civita.

name: Monte Carlo
summary: Random sampling was used on computers to solve deterministic problems.
